title: Exact common-chart multiplicities for square-zero radical targets
body:
This scoped counting proof answers the common-chart multiplicity question in [PR #4766](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4766). It gives the complete distribution of admissible projective row/column pairs over every finite field and every radical dimension. A six-case table refines the existing reachable/unreachable count. The complete kappa calculation is unchanged.

[Proof and scope](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f4ad0d3eeaddb596f062a2b60085745e23cbedd6/research/radical-chart-multiplicity/README.md), [exact checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f4ad0d3eeaddb596f062a2b60085745e23cbedd6/research/radical-chart-multiplicity/verify.py), [replay declaration](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f4ad0d3eeaddb596f062a2b60085745e23cbedd6/research/radical-chart-multiplicity/VERIFY.json), and [source provenance](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f4ad0d3eeaddb596f062a2b60085745e23cbedd6/research/radical-chart-multiplicity/SOURCES.json) are pinned to the reviewed commit. Base: canonical main `ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf`, priority revision 7.

CPython 3.12.14 registered normal and optimized replays passed: 1,065,033 target tuples, 1,928 independently enumerated subspaces and six controls. Both print `PASS_RADICAL_CHART_MULTIPLICITY`; the launcher prints `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`. All five package files match their committed bytes, and the base is an ancestor of the package commit.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/radical-chart-multiplicity
```

Use Python 3.12 and the standard library. No external runtime inputs or third-party Python packages are required. Hosted planning and the registered package replay passed on this exact head in [run 39991699175](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39991699175). No predecessor scientific suite, selected cold replay, native replay, compiler, Lean or Docker build was run. The optional full-history preflight is unavailable in this shallow checkout. Finite checks corroborate the written proof; they do not constitute independent human or proof-kernel acceptance.

Bind a restricted common-chart policy to a physical caller and price its choice and emission. Source preparation, native operations, precision, movement, and supplier/outer admission remain separate obligations.

Credit Nick Petalas's [PR #4766](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4766) for the all-field reachability count and explicit multiplicity question, and his [PR #4745](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4745) for the arbitrary-word square-zero reachability theorem. The [pinned reachability proof](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf/research/square-zero-radical-reachability/README.md) supplies the paid-cost interpretation: k>0 gives exact formal cost two, while k=0 is unreachable at any word length. That theorem is cited, not independently re-audited here. ToikY's [PR #4334](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4334) supplies the shared-chart interface; Wentao Li's [PR #4099](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4099) supplies the right-vector alphabet. The finite-geometry incidence counts are classical; no general literature-priority claim is made.

Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.
